minors.where: scene-3x west postern x~35-155, y~580-770; wall_ring postern W x~50-205 and E x~1040-1200, y~340-525; wall_parts x~50-205, y~385-620

minors.issue: Snow-covered vertical walkways are almost the same value as the snow ground. Only the thin parapet line and a dark inner edge separate them, so at 1x the vertical walls read weaker than in default/desert.
The E-W road runs flat into the east vertical wall walkway with no postern or end treatment. It is a plausible dead end, but it looks unfinished next to the west postern.

outOfScope: river-7 / river-11 / desert-29 / snow-77: interior paths do not lead to the wall stairs (stair feet land on open ground); generator layout, not kit art.
snow-77: tree clusters and the frozen pond have hard rectangular-ish outlines in places (pre-existing chipset art).
desert-29: the sand path tiles are very low contrast against the sand ground (pre-existing road art).
summary: 3/4 view holds throughout. Horizontal walls show crenellated walkway tops plus 4-row coursed stone faces. North walls correctly show their inner (south) face, and vertical walls are 2-wide walkways with an outer parapet. Towers and gatehouses read as projecting volumes, with tops, machicolation rows, front faces stepping one row forward, and cast shadows to the right and below. Stone texture is good: varied block tones, mortar, weathering, vines, arrow slits, banners and torches. It is in the same visual family as the Beodeul castle reference and not toy-like. Rings close with no gaps. The gatehouse road enters the roof edge and exits through the arch. Stairs descend the inner north face onto walkable ground. Snow and desert match default in quality. Remaining issues are minor: the postern is under-height relative to the 4-row wall and its tunnel is shown only as seams; a light seam frame on the desert postern; road/stair-foot offset in the scene; flat pale shadow blocks on snowy walkways; low-contrast snow vertical walls. No majors, so PASS.
